_IFLogger_Note: IFLogger ships this service's logs to LoggerWebService. SharedEstateService gives it an Information floor, which would drop every Debug line (route entry, store writes, file serving, ingest sheet-by-sheet detail). CategoryOverrides lifts everything under the 'Autofills' category prefix (the controllers, store and request logging; longest matching prefix wins) to Debug. Remove the entry, or raise it to Information, to quieten the service.
_GroupSizes_Note: Max people per group, keyed by the exact sheet/sale name (trimmed) - used both to pad short groups and to reject a group that's over the limit. Any sheet not listed here (including a brand new sale sheet added later) falls back to BusWankers.DEFAULT_MAX_IN_A_GROUP (6) in code, matching 'assume 6 per group for each for now' - only add an entry here if a particular sale ever needs a different size.
_Auth_Note: Who may update the autofill files (POST /api/autofill/ingest, /sheets, /generate): members of this Keycloak group, read from the 'groups' claim of the access token (the BusWankers user client needs a Group Membership mapper - claim name 'groups', added to the access token and ID token). Everyone else who is signed in gets 403 on those routes. Omit the setting to use the default, 'uploaders'.
_AutofillStore_Note: Where POST /api/autofill/ingest writes the live autofill files and GET /api/autofill/files/{filename} serves them from. Must be OUTSIDE the deploy path (buswankers-remote-install.sh wipes that on every deploy) - the installer creates this default and chowns it to the service account. For a local `dotnet run` override it with the env var AutofillStore__Directory (launchSettings.json does this) - there is deliberately no appsettings.Development.json: the service runs as ASP.NET Production everywhere (SharedEstateService, see Program.cs), so that file would never be read.
_Ntp_Note: GET /api/time (the page's sale-day launcher) corrects this box's clock against a real NTP server - see NtpClock.cs. Servers are tried in order; each is asked Exchanges times and the shortest round trip wins; the offset is cached for a minute. intelligence's firewall must allow outbound UDP/123.
_IF_Note: ServiceFactory bootstrap config (see Program.cs). No Kestrel:Endpoints block here any more - IFGlobal.PortResolver.GetPort() picks the listen port (UploaderService -> 5038) instead of a hardcoded URL.
